column1: # One row per enemy archetype. Edit to retune; refresh npm run dev to see changes.
#   displayName     — Human-readable name shown in the gym index and editor.
#   formationKind   — Formation builder: v | diver | rect | swarm | orbital | single
#   count           — Number of enemies in the formation.
#   spacingX        — Horizontal spacing between formation slots (px).
#   spacingY        — Vertical spacing between formation slots (px).
#   driftSpeed      — Rightward drift speed of the formation (px/s).
#   startXMin       — Minimum spawn X (px); equal to startXMax for a fixed position.
#   startYMin       — Minimum spawn Y (px); equal to startYMax for a fixed position.
#   health          — Hit points before destruction (positive integer
#   shotPattern     — Shot pattern: none | aimed | spread | radial | orbital | coordinated
#   shotProbability — Chance (0.0–1.0) an individual enemy fires per shot cycle.
#   marchStep       — Horizontal step (px) for the `march` formation (neutral on other kinds).
#   marchDrop       — Vertical drop (px) per arena-edge reversal for the `march` formation.
#   beamDuration    — Tractor-beam lifetime (ms) for the `capturer` archetype (neutral otherwise).
#   pullStrength    — Bounded tractor-beam pull speed (px/s) for the `capturer` archetype.
#   hordeGroupSize  — Grunts released per spawn group by the `grunt` homing-horde spawner (neutral otherwise).
#   hordeSpawnInterval — Seconds between `grunt` homing-horde spawn groups (neutral otherwise).
#   attackSpeed     — Committed attack-run speed (px/s) for the `raider` patrol/attack archetype (neutral otherwise).
#   commitRange     — Distance (px) within which the `raider` commits to an attack run (neutral otherwise).
# To add a new enemy: add a new row with a unique key. The gym index will
# discover it automatically. Ensure all required columns have values.
